# Wolvec

> Wolvec is an AI platform for fitness coaches, the whole coaching setup rather than an add-on to it. Each coach's AI is set up from one guided conversation about how they coach, with no existing content library required, then works from it to draft programs and answer routine client questions. It also includes workout logging and weekly check-ins.

Wolvec is not a medical provider, health plan, or healthcare clearinghouse. It provides fitness and wellness coaching support only, and does not diagnose, treat, or give medical advice.

## How it works

- One guided conversation builds the coach's AI. No existing content library is required.
- Coaches choose how client chat is handled: All off, Drafted for review (the default), or Fully autonomous, and can change it at any time. Safety controls and location based restrictions can require Coach review even when the coach chooses Fully autonomous. Program changes always need the coach's approval.
- Wolvec uses limited automated safety controls for certain reports of pain, injury, illness, dizziness, chest or breathing symptoms, and other physical distress. Depending on the circumstances, those controls may pause AI-assisted coaching, display a safety notice, or flag the issue for the Client's assigned Coach in Wolvec. These controls may not identify every health or safety concern and are not medical or emergency monitoring.
- Wolvec is available only to coaches and clients age 18 or older.
- New clients complete a PAR-Q+ pre-participation health screening, which the coach reviews before the AI begins full interaction.

## Programming and tracking

- Exercise library: nearly 1,400 exercises with animated demonstrations. Coaches can add their own exercises and their own video links.
- Program building: the AI drafts programs based on how the coach coaches, and the coach approves each week before the client sees it. Coaches can edit any program (swap exercises, adjust sets and reps, restructure), or build their own workouts from the exercise library and reuse them as templates.
- Workout formats: coaches can add superset, circuit, AMRAP, EMOM and timed blocks to a program.
- Reusable program templates.
- Progress tracking: clients log every set, and coaches see each logged session.
- Weekly check-ins and optional post-workout ratings.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://wolvec.ai/): product overview, how it works, FAQ.
- [Free guides and tools](https://wolvec.ai/resources): Free guides for personal trainers and online fitness coaches, and free lifting tools, including an RPE calculator and an RPE chart.
- [How to become an online fitness coach](https://wolvec.ai/guides/how-to-become-an-online-fitness-coach): How to become an online fitness coach, step by step: certification, scope, your niche and offer, business basics, your coaching system and first clients.
- [How to get clients as a personal trainer](https://wolvec.ai/guides/how-to-get-clients-as-a-personal-trainer): How personal trainers get clients, in person or online: a clear offer, your network, referrals, local partners, Google Business Profile and follow-up.
- [RPE calculator and RPE chart](https://wolvec.ai/tools/rpe-calculator): RPE calculator and RPE chart for lifting. Enter a recent set to estimate a target weight, and see what each RPE scale rating means in reps in reserve.
- [One rep max calculator](https://wolvec.ai/tools/one-rep-max-calculator): One rep max calculator. Estimate your one-rep max (1RM) and five-rep max (5RM) from a recent 1 to 9 rep set you already performed to failure.
- [Bench press calculator](https://wolvec.ai/tools/bench-press-calculator): Bench press 1RM calculator. Estimate your bench press 1RM and five-rep max from a recent 1 to 9 rep set you already performed to failure.
- [Squat max calculator](https://wolvec.ai/tools/squat-max-calculator): Squat max calculator. Estimate your squat 1RM and five-rep max from a recent 1 to 9 rep set you already performed to failure.
- [Deadlift calculator](https://wolvec.ai/tools/deadlift-calculator): Deadlift calculator. Estimate your deadlift 1RM and five-rep max from a recent 1 to 9 rep set you already performed to failure.
- [DOTS score calculator](https://wolvec.ai/tools/dots-calculator): DOTS score calculator for powerlifting. Enter a total and body weight in lb or kg to see the DOTS score, with the Wilks score alongside for comparison.
- [Wilks calculator](https://wolvec.ai/tools/wilks-calculator): Wilks calculator for powerlifting. Enter a total and body weight in lb or kg to see the Wilks score from the original formula, with the DOTS score alongside.
- [Plate calculator](https://wolvec.ai/tools/plate-calculator): Barbell plate calculator. Enter a target weight in lb or kg, choose your bar and the plates you have, and see which weight plates go on each side.
- [Privacy Policy](https://wolvec.ai/privacy): data collection, use, and consumer health data disclosures.
- [Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy](https://wolvec.ai/consumer-health-data): consumer health data categories, sources, purposes, sharing, and consumer rights.
- [Blog](https://wolvec.ai/blog): no posts published yet as of this writing.
- [Changelog](https://wolvec.ai/changelog): no entries published yet as of this writing.
